terminal_business_outcome: Approved, funded and governed portfolio/programme/project commitments
authoritative_object_families: Strategy; Objective; Scenario; Business Plan; Initiative; KPI; Portfolio; Programme; Project
critical_handoff_rule: Strategic priorities and approved plans become portfolio/project demand without re-keying.
erp_acceptance_rule: One traceable chain from strategic objective through approved initiative to funded delivery context.

trigger: Idea, requirement or product/service change demand
terminal_business_outcome: Released product/service definition and controlled configuration
authoritative_object_families: Idea; Requirement; Concept; Business Case; Product; Service; Product Configuration; Quality Plan; Technical Document
critical_handoff_rule: Approved requirements and design definitions flow into released configuration with exact review/decision evidence.
erp_acceptance_rule: Released definition is reproducible, revision-controlled and usable downstream without external runtime dependency.

authoritative_object_families: Lead; Customer; Account; Opportunity; Quote; Proposal; Bid; Sales Order; Contract; Obligation; Invoice
critical_handoff_rule: Customer/opportunity identity persists through bid, approval, contract and downstream order/project creation.
erp_acceptance_rule: No duplicate customer/opportunity/contract master and commercial approval is preserved as attributable Decision evidence.

terminal_business_outcome: Delivered obligation, customer acceptance, invoice and settled receivable
authoritative_object_families: Sales Order; Demand; Inventory Item; Shipment; Production Order; Service Order; Service Acceptance; Invoice; Payment
critical_handoff_rule: Order demand drives supply/production/service fulfilment and accepted fulfilment drives billing without re-entry.
erp_acceptance_rule: Order, fulfilment, acceptance, invoice, ledger and payment remain linked through authoritative identifiers.

trigger: Approved demand for externally supplied goods/services
terminal_business_outcome: Received/accepted supply and settled supplier liability
authoritative_object_families: Supplier Relationship; Requisition; Sourcing Event; RFx; Supplier Response; Purchase Order; Goods Receipt; Contract; Invoice; Payment
critical_handoff_rule: Approved demand becomes sourcing/PO; receipt and contractual acceptance become payable evidence.
erp_acceptance_rule: Supplier, PO, receipt, invoice, accounting and payment reconcile to the same obligation and quantities/values.

trigger: Forecast, customer demand or project/material requirement
terminal_business_outcome: Demand satisfied through planned supply, inventory, production or logistics
authoritative_object_families: Demand Forecast; Sales Order; Material Requirement; Supply Plan; Inventory Policy; Purchase Order; Stock Position; Production Order; Shipment
critical_handoff_rule: One demand signal is netted/planned and fulfilled through the chosen source without parallel demand records.
erp_acceptance_rule: Planned demand, commitments, stock, WIP and fulfilment quantities reconcile end to end.

terminal_business_outcome: Competent employed person actively deployed into governed work context
authoritative_object_families: Requisition; Candidate; Employment; Person; Position; Position Occupancy; Job Profile; Competence Evidence; Functional Deployment; Deployment Assignment
critical_handoff_rule: Employment/position state enables but does not replace contextual deployment, permission or authority.
erp_acceptance_rule: A person reaches My Work only through valid employment/position, job capability, deployment, competence and access gates.

terminal_business_outcome: Closed period, reconciled ledgers and governed financial statements/management reporting
authoritative_object_families: Account; Ledger; Journal; Invoice; Payment; Cash Position; Financial Statement; KPI; Report
critical_handoff_rule: Operational transactions create controlled accounting consequences and reporting uses governed ledger/semantic sources.
erp_acceptance_rule: Financial statements and management metrics trace to posted source transactions and close controls.

terminal_business_outcome: Accepted project outputs, commissioned systems/assets and closed delivery obligations
authoritative_object_families: Project; WBS; Project Schedule; Requirement; Design Model; Drawing; Cost Plan; Contract; Work Package; Field Evidence; Inspection; Test Pack; Handover Package; Asset
critical_handoff_rule: Project scope, design, procurement, site delivery, commercial status, quality and handover operate on one project/work-package/object graph.
erp_acceptance_rule: Handover is accepted only when scope, configuration, commercial, quality, information and asset obligations reconcile.

terminal_business_outcome: Approved and issued exact design information/configuration for downstream use
authoritative_object_families: Requirement; Design Model; Model Element; Drawing; Calculation; Design Check; Technical Document; Review Package; Transmittal
critical_handoff_rule: Design authoring binds to controlled requirements and exact revisions; issue/acceptance never refers to an ambiguous latest file.
erp_acceptance_rule: Downstream procurement/construction consumes an identifiable approved/issued configuration with review and Decision evidence.

trigger: Customer, asset or operational service demand
terminal_business_outcome: Completed and accepted service with evidence, SLA outcome and financial consequence where applicable
authoritative_object_families: Service Request; Case; Service Order; Appointment; Dispatch; Field Work Record; Inspection; Test; Work Order; Service Acceptance; Invoice
critical_handoff_rule: Request/case becomes scheduled accountable field work; completion evidence precedes acceptance and billing.
erp_acceptance_rule: Request, assignment, execution evidence, acceptance, SLA and invoice remain linked and auditable.

trigger: Approved asset need / capital or operational demand
terminal_business_outcome: Controlled operational asset history through acquisition, operation, maintenance and retirement
authoritative_object_families: Purchase Order; Goods Receipt; Fixed Asset; Asset; Property; Facility; Maintenance Plan; Work Order; Service Order; Digital Twin; Record
critical_handoff_rule: Procured/constructed asset identity transitions into operational asset master without creating a disconnected maintenance identity.
erp_acceptance_rule: Acquisition cost, configuration, location, maintenance, condition, records and retirement remain traceable to one asset identity.

trigger: Quality, HSE, operational, compliance or security deviation
terminal_business_outcome: Verified correction/corrective action and controlled closure
authoritative_object_families: Non-Conformance; Defect; CAPA; Finding; Issue; Remediation Action; HSE Incident; Security Incident
critical_handoff_rule: Observed deviation creates governed investigation/remediation rather than a detached task or overwritten status.
erp_acceptance_rule: Closure requires attributable root-cause/action evidence, applicable authority and verification of effectiveness.

trigger: Approved need to alter controlled business/technical configuration
terminal_business_outcome: Verified implemented change and new reproducible baseline
authoritative_object_families: Change; Affected Object; Impact Assessment; Implementation Action; Verification; Configuration Item; Baseline; Effectivity; Configuration Resolution Run
critical_handoff_rule: Every material controlled change identifies affected objects, impact, authority, implementation and verification.
erp_acceptance_rule: The system can reconstruct before/after configuration and the Decision/evidence authorising and proving the change.

terminal_business_outcome: Closed contractual/commercial position and agreed final account
authoritative_object_families: Construction Contract; Obligation; Instruction; Variation; Measurement; Valuation; Payment Certificate; Forecast; Final Account; Invoice; Payment
critical_handoff_rule: Contract instructions/change feed measurement, valuation, forecast and finance without detached commercial spreadsheets as authoritative truth.
erp_acceptance_rule: Final account reconciles original contract, approved changes, valuations, certificates, invoices/payments and outstanding obligations.

trigger: IT service demand, incident or detected problem
terminal_business_outcome: Restored/fulfilled service with controlled configuration/knowledge consequence
authoritative_object_families: IT Service; Service Request; Incident; Problem; IT Change; Configuration Item; Release; Deployment; Security Incident; Knowledge Item
critical_handoff_rule: Operational resolution links service request/incident, change, configuration and release instead of using disconnected ticket states.
erp_acceptance_rule: Closure preserves affected configuration, implemented change/release, verification and reusable knowledge/evidence.

trigger: New/changed obligation, policy need or governance decision
terminal_business_outcome: Effective policy/control framework with assurance evidence and governed remediation
authoritative_object_families: Policy; Obligation; Control; Process; SOP; Control Test; Audit; Finding; Remediation Action; Record
critical_handoff_rule: Approved policy/obligation becomes machine-enforceable process/control requirements where applicable.
erp_acceptance_rule: Assurance can demonstrate which effective policy/control governed work, tests performed, findings and verified remediation.
